historical_record.description: A. Carlisle & Co. Building, designed by Herman C. Baumann.

Completed as the A. Carlisle & Company printing and lithography building, with a central vertical shaft inset with glass blocks breaking up continuous ribbons of horizontal windows. The 1976 Department of City Planning Architectural Survey noted its 'powerful Moderne imagery'; a superb example of industrial Art Moderne design, it was put forward for San Francisco Landmark designation.

building.name: A. Carlisle & Company Building
building.completed_conflict: This building's context statement dates the work 1947; the assessor's roll records the parcel as built 1948.

historic_survey.note: The survey dates the building 1947; the assessor's roll gives 1948. The report dates the building to 1948 in its narrative and 1947 in its landmark recommendations.
